stories.heading: Federal Reserve Ends Enforcement Action Against Bank of Eufaula
claim_text: The Federal Reserve Board announced the termination of an enforcement action involving SNB Bancshares and the Bank of Eufaula, located in Eufaula, Oklahoma.
The enforcement action, which was originally established as a written agreement dated August 7, 2024, was officially terminated on September 3, 2026.

stories.heading: CMS Delays Medicaid Work Requirement Deadline for States
claim_text: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services extended the deadline for states to implement Medicaid work requirements by six months to June 30.
CMS offered states a hold-harmless option that postpones penalties while state agencies address eligibility verification challenges.
State officials requested additional time, reporting that current IT infrastructure and funding are inadequate for the mandatory eligibility checks.
CMS directed state Medicaid directors to use the extension to modernize IT systems, streamline applications, and improve administrative workflows.
A report from the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation estimates that up to 10.1 million individuals could lose Medicaid coverage once work requirements take effect.
